name: My Tho food guide
summary: Hủ tiếu Mỹ Tho is the bowl with a photograph: dry, or with broth, at breakfast, lunch, or supper. Elephant-ear fish, ginger honey tea, coconut candy, night-court sweets, and bánh tét are named and not pictured. A stall price is check on arrival.
body: Eat the town bowl in the streets or at the pier court on đường 30 Tháng 4. The strand is the Gò Cát rice noodle. The workshop at Hội Gia is where you watch it made, not where you sit down with the bowl.
specialtiesLead: The photographed specialty is hủ tiếu Mỹ Tho. Plates without a photograph stay off the grid.
seoTitle: My Tho food guide — hu tieu, and what is not pictured
seoDescription: Hủ tiếu Mỹ Tho is the photographed bowl, dry or with broth. Islet plates and night-court sweets are named and not pictured. Stall prices are check on arrival.
